summary: Netflix Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders held on June 4, 2026. All 12 director nominees were elected, and proposals to ratify Ernst & Young as auditor and approve executive compensation passed. Four non-binding stockholder proposals failed. This is a routine current report on shareholder votes, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change occurred.
